title.narrative: 2X Global membership and Gender Lens Investing activities (Global) 2023 - 2024

description.narrative: 2X Global is a global membership and field-building organisation that promotes gender lens investing (GLI) with investors, capital providers, and intermediaries working in public and private markets, across developed and emerging economies. The 2X Global network engages through: Communities of Practice to advance intersectional investment agendas; educational forums; shared resources and tools that help deliver gender-smart investments; certification and standards that support scaling of the GLI field; and deal-sharing platform and networks for capital deployment. The 2022 Development Finance Review recommended DFAT join 2X Global to both access membership benefits and to draw and increase 2X attention to the Asia-Pacific region. Donor membership is via funding for 2X activities. In 2023 we supported the 'Ignite' program in the Asia-Pacific to build the capacity of women fund managers to design and develop their gender-lens investment funds and help them raise capital from investors.
